clues.text: Standing 39 feet tall with a top speed of 31 mph, this pint-sized coaster keeps things smooth and upright with zero inversions.
This coaster was crafted by German manufacturer ART Engineering and opened to the public in 2025.
You can find this ride at an amusement park located in North Carolina.
This steel launched coaster treats younger guests to thrills at Carowinds.
The attraction's name features Charlie Brown's iconic pet beagle competing on a high-speed locomotive track.

evidence.quote: Snoopy's Racing Railway is a steel launched roller coaster built by German manufacturer ART Engineering currently located at Carowinds in Charlotte, North Carolina, USA.
